speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms. To begin, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the rash appear on the backs of your hands as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pityriasis Lichenoides et Varioliformis Acutum (PLEVA) or secondary syphilis; however, the palm involvement suggests a parasitic infestation such as scabies (noting the patient's history of farming/livestock) or an arthropod-borne infection like leishmaniasis. Given the specific distribution (upper body, face, palms) and occupation, I will request a skin scraping and blood work for syphilis and HIV.
